research.selection.activity.reversal_vol.name: 相近波动分层后的反转选择

definition.formula: Within amount stratum split vol60 into2halves, select top floor(n_half/5) -hot per half retaining n_half/N weight
definition.endpoints: formation monthend and nextmonth opening quote

policy.selection: Formation at month-end using only prior/current formation data; 3 amount strata; five oriented reversal groups, matched-count lowvol, all eligible pool, and within-volatility-half reversal.
policy.weights: Equal weights in each target group; volatility-controlled reversal retains each volatility half original n_half/N capital weight.
policy.cash: Zero cash interest. Failed buys retain cash; failed sells remain held; no redistribution to successful stocks.
policy.fees: 0 and25 bps each side on actually simulated traded value. Assumed scenario only; personal schedule unknown.
policy.rebalance: Monthly targets after T close, one rebalance at next scheduled exchange-day open.
policy.execution: Opening fields and prior breaks only; closing audit after orders. Hypothetical opening-quote fractional units, not verified fills.
policy.exit: Target reductions sold only when qualified opening quote exists; failed sell held; no terminal forced liquidation.
policy.reentry: Only next scheduled monthly target; no daily retries.
policy.investability: Fixed2014 cohort conditional adjusted-price quote account; queue, actual auction fills, round lots, delisting cash and dividend accounting not fully qualified.
